title: First Mid Insurance Group Earns Spot on Business Insurance’s Top 100 U.S. Brokers List
summary: Mattoon, IL (July 27, 2026) First Mid Insurance Group has earned a place on Business Insurances prestigious Top 100 U.S. Brokers list for the first time, ranking No. 95 among insurance brokerage firms nationwide. Published annually by Business Insurance, the Top 100 U.S. Brokers ranking recognizes the nations largest insurance brokerage firms based on U.S. brokerage revenue. Widely regarded as one of the insurance industrys leading benchmarks, the list reflects sustained growth and market strength. This recognition is a reflection of our outstanding team, said Clay Dean, Chief Executive Officer of First Mid Insurance Group. Earning a place among the Top 100 insurance brokers in the nation for the first time is an important milestone, and one our employees should be proud of.
